sentences.text:
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual  /Physical Mode).
2.
This I.A has been filed seeking modification of order dated 03.10.2023.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that inadvertently wrong offences as well as the Court name has been typed out while typing the order dated 03.10.2023.
He further contended that the offences as well as the Court name has been rightly reflected in the body of the bail application.
4. Considering such submissions the prayer for modification is allowed.
Accordingly the offences are reflected in Para-3 be substituted by the offences as mentioned in Para-1 of the bail application that is "363,366(A),376(2), (n) of IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act."

Similarly the name of the Court as indicated in Para-5 is be substituted by the Court name as has been reflected Para-1 of the bail application that is "Learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Court, under POCSO Act, Dhenkanal".
In view of the aforesaid modification the time to surrender be extended by further a period of four weeks.
With the aforesaid observation the I.A. stands disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
